title: Culture Clash
summary: An Aeon essay examining the famous intellectual clash between C.P. Snow's 'Two Cultures' thesis advocating for scientific literacy and F.R. Leavis's defense of the humanities, exploring how this 1959 debate continues to shape discussions about the divide between science and the liberal arts.
problem_solved: Provides historical and philosophical context for understanding the enduring tension between scientific and humanistic modes of knowledge.
why_valuable: Offers nuanced analysis of a foundational cultural debate that remains relevant to contemporary STEM vs. humanities educational discourse.
